findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, while you do not have a reciprocal right.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the other party.

findings.explanation: Intellectual property ownership transfers immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment, leaving you unprotected if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables, all right, title, and interest in such deliverables shall vest in the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers immediately upon creation rather than upon full payment, leaving me unprotected if payment fails. I propose changing this so that ownership vests upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables. - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, the current terms exclude certain items from the liability cap, which creates potential exposure. I propose modifying this so that each party's total liability is limited to the sum of all amounts received under the agreement. Thank you, and I look forward to getting started.
